usageTips.title: Generate a passphrase
usageTips.description: Select the Password or Passphrase card to reveal its settings and red Generate button. Adjust the settings before you generate. Copy to Clipboard is visible for either choice and becomes available after you generate a result.

usageTips.title: Read and select results on larger screens
usageTips.description: In the desktop layout, long results wrap inside the result field. Use Tab to focus it, then Ctrl+A on Windows or Command+A on macOS to select the entire result.

usageTips.title: Reset generator options
usageTips.description: Select Reset beside User Guide to restore the default options, clear the displayed result, and deselect Password or Passphrase. Recent history stays available for this session, and Keep history after refresh returns to off.

usageTips.title: User guide and release notes
usageTips.description: Keep using this app’s existing guide and release notes for feature instructions and version history.
